scope: Spot executionReport notifications and independent explicit Spot account monitoring, sharing the existing wallet-isolated inbox with futures.
native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, APK installation, mobile storage/force-kill or actual wallet/private stream validation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux lacks macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
boundaries: Real exchange acceptance of same-EOA user/signer, enable-trading, real Privy/EOA wallet round-trip and Spot private streams remain unverified.
Manual start/renew only. Background resume/reconnect reuses valid in-memory keys without signing. Stop disconnects locally without invalidating keys that may be shared with other clients.
Only connected authorized live events are collected. No system push, background guarantee or missed-event backfill; explicit signed reads remain necessary after gaps.
Spot buys/sells never imply long/short positions or futures PnL/reduce-only/liquidation fields. Y/Z and other amounts remain exact Decimal values with independent Spot units.
O=0 or absent creation time is unknown, not an epoch-date claim. MARKET positive quote-budget Q may accompany zero original base quantity.
Existing v1 futures entries/read state are retained. The same wallet/symbol/order/trade identity in SPOT and PERP remains distinct.
Local inbox keeps at most 500 recent records and 4 MiB across wallets, preserving failure/retry/read-state and wallet-isolation boundaries. It is not complete exchange history.
Deposit/withdrawal history first-load baseline, state transitions and event-triggered history refresh are not yet connected. Balance updates alone never prove on-chain transfer completion.
Other PRD gaps remain: enable-trading, subaccounts, deposit/withdrawal/transfers, complete valuation, Chase/BBO/Scaled. BAPI historical statistics and TWAP skipped this phase at user request.
build_notes: Build passed with the existing future KGP compatibility warning from third-party native plugins.
